goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: The f4e1368 product baseline is strong but not exit-ready. Fresh approved Phase 3 commands pass, including installed Chrome 151, yet verify:phase3 omits unit, visual, private-acceptance, and aggregate-receipt gates. No fresh two-run aggregate receipt or complete invariant matrix exists; Chrome QA does not assert page errors, failed requests, or unexpected network traffic; and worktree-local visual proof currently fails on a hard-coded node_modules path. Approve one proof-only vertical slice that repairs those harness gaps, generates byte-stable sanitized evidence, and changes no product behavior.

evidence.proof: Product implementation is unchanged from f4e1368; HEAD 5b9d419 adds only the aggregate GoalBuddy board. git status --short and git diff --check were clean.

Fresh npm run test:phase3:service passed 2 files and 14 tests, covering sole-writer lock, SQLite boundary, CAS concurrency, rejection atomicity, idempotency, branch/claim controls, and post-commit metadata.
Fresh npm run test:phase3:recovery passed 2 files and 34 tests, including authoring/control kill points, lost responses, migrations, integrity, unsupported schema, and claim-secret retry.
Fresh npm run test:phase3:parity passed 5 files and 13 tests. It proves shared protocol behavior and equal-store CLI/editor parity, but not two complete clean aggregate repetitions.

Fresh npm run test:phase3:browser passed 13 tests. Fresh npm run qa:chrome passed using installed Google Chrome 151.0.7922.138 and reran 13 browser tests; compiler-native output, native CSSAnimation, reconnect/refetch, dirty-draft conflict, branches/claims, and reduced-motion inspection passed.

Fresh npm run verify:phase3 passed service 14, recovery 34, parity 13, browser 13, installed-Chrome QA, determinism 26, browser 20, typecheck, build, sensitive scan, private-ignore scan, and its current diff guard.
motion-protocol strict shared commands, CLI tests, parity.test.ts, branch-claim-parity.test.ts, and Phase 3 browser durable dispatch passed fresh.
service.test.ts passed second-lock rejection, node:sqlite import-boundary inspection, WAL/FULL/foreign-key configuration, and lock-holder death closure.
Fresh service/recovery suites passed same-base race, stale/invalid unchanged snapshots, injected faults, control CAS, and restart pre/post-state assertions.
Fresh branch-claim and branch-claim-recovery suites passed capability, overlap, scope, expiry/revoke, lifecycle, concurrency, and verifier-only persistence cases.
Fresh protocol tests rejected selector addressing; import tests proved identity survives selector renaming; browser tests preserved selection by canonical IDs across branch availability.

During the supplemental unit run, all 42 css-import tests passed, including atomic unsupported binding, script/external-resource, and orphan-override rejection. The overall unit command later failed in an unrelated visual attestation test.

Fresh compiler determinism passed 26 tests, including three-run HTML/CSS/digest/receipt identity, and parity passed equal-store comparisons. Missing: one two-run aggregate editor/CLI artifact and receipt comparison.
Fresh browser and installed-Chrome checks asserted iframe srcdoc equals compiledHtml, immutable refetch occurs after SSE, and native CSSAnimation instances drive playback.
Fresh compiler determinism, browser, and Chrome checks passed native HTML/CSS output with no alternate interpolator.
Fresh installed-Chrome QA reported reducedMotionInspectable=true; existing browser/compiler verification passed. It must be named explicitly in the aggregate matrix.

npm run test:visual passed its controlled three-replay, discrete-boundary proof. check:sensitive passed with findingCount 0 across 169 tracked files and zero untracked files; check:private-ignore passed 3/3 ignored and zero tracked private targets.

npm run test:unit produced 197 passes and one failure because authoring.visual.test.ts assumes worktree-local node_modules/playwright-core/browsers.json. npm run verify:receipts failed because the ignored fresh private receipt was absent. Current qa:chrome captures console errors but not pageerror, requestfailed, or unexpected-network evidence.

Require verify:phase3 to invoke every approved command plus unit, all visual suites, private acceptance, receipt verification, typecheck/build, scans, and a ten-invariant aggregate receipt; T003 must inspect the command expansion and fresh logs.

Run two clean equal-base editor/CLI proof repetitions and compare canonical bytes/digests, compiled HTML and CSS bytes, export digests, sanitized revision/control receipts, and the complete aggregate receipt byte-for-byte.

Require installed-Chrome pageerror/requestfailed/network allowlist assertions, banned-field/value receipt assertions, sensitive/private-ignore scans, tracked-artifact inventory, complete f4e1368 diff inspection, and zero SQLite/WAL/screenshots/private payloads.

parallel_safety.reason: Use one Worker. The package touches shared package command wiring and a single aggregate evidence contract; splitting it would make command coverage and receipt provenance ambiguous.

missing_evidence: No fresh byte-identical two-run aggregate receipt from identical clean bases.
verify:phase3 currently omits test:unit, test:visual, Phase 2 visual suites, test:private-acceptance, and verify:receipts.
Installed-Chrome QA does not directly assert uncaught page errors, failed requests, or an explicit unexpected-network allowlist.
Worktree execution of authoring.visual.test.ts fails because Playwright metadata is resolved through a nonexistent worktree-local node_modules path.
The ignored private acceptance manifest/receipt was unavailable in this worktree, so fresh private import and private visual evidence were not produced.
No single sanitized artifact maps all ten invariants, exact commands, counts, environment, stable digests, Chrome result, and repository/privacy gates.
